name: Buddy
subtitle: Buddy, your AI helper in the Dynamic Island

apps.name: Buddy
apps.subtitle: Ask anything from the Dynamic Island
apps.localizedDescription: Buddy lives in your Dynamic Island. Tap it to ask, or double-tap the back of your iPhone to send a screenshot - the answer appears right in the island while you stay in your app. Free brain, no account.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Safer updates on Windows: if the update helper runs again after an update is already installed, it now leaves Buddy alone instead of swapping folders and rolling back.
• Mac and iPhone keep their updates when a release only ships a Windows fix (the update manifest carries them forward from the last release that has them).

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Buddy looks at your latest screenshot only when you ask about it.
